fact: Proclamation No. 75 of 1995 establishes the Eritrean Standards Institution as an autonomous body with legal personality, the sole national organ for standardization, quality assurance and metrology, with power to prepare compulsory Eritrean Standards; the abstract names no information technology or data standard.
ISO states ESI was established in 1995 by Proclamation No. 75/1995 as the sole standardization body in Eritrea, with 446 national standards published.
